title: Zeppelin

description.en: Next-generation spacecraft fleet and design archive
description.zh: 次世代太空舰队与原创设计档案

subject: Titanium command vessel with paired propulsion nacelles and yellow identification bands

subject.en: Titanium fleet command vessel with yellow bands
subject.zh: 带黄色识别带的钛金属舰队指挥舰

description.en: A substantial central hull and paired nacelles form a complete diagonal mark. Uniform placement preserves the prow, antennae and engine housings with rounded-outline clearance.
description.zh: 厚实中轴舰体与成对推进舱构成完整斜向标志。整体等比放置，保留舰艏、天线与引擎外壳，并留出圆角边界净空。

description.en: Satin titanium armor, graphite joints, yellow enamel and amber engine cores use continuous physical 3D shading. This symbolic identity is separate from the documented fleet designs.
description.zh: 缎面钛装甲、石墨接缝、黄色珐琅与琥珀引擎核心采用连续的实体三维明暗。象征性标志与实际舰型档案独立。

description.en: Staggered approach chevrons, broken range arcs and docking ticks are pressed into cool engineering paper. Background, grain and soft shadows stay separate from the transparent ship.
description.zh: 冷调工程纸上压印错落的接近向量、断开的测距弧与对接刻度。底纹、颗粒和柔和投影均独立于透明舰船。

palette.source: artwork/logo-family/zeppelin/2026-09-19-01/presentation.json background.base; authored presentation, not a website token

sizeNote.en: 24/16px marks retain the broad hull, twin engines and yellow bands. Fine seams and antennae soften. Use transparent foregrounds without tiles or extra masks.
sizeNote.zh: 24/16px 以宽舰体、双引擎与黄色识别带保持辨识，细接缝和天线会柔化。小标志使用透明前景，不加底板或额外遮罩。

palette.source: artwork/logo-family/zeppelin/2026-09-19-01/presentation.json background.base; authored presentation, not a website token

source.description: Next-generation spacecraft fleet and design archive

goal.en: Explore an original industrial science-fiction fleet through 17 mission series and 25 archive entries. Three modeled vessels provide seven preserved HD views each; planned designs keep explicit placeholders and unknown dimensions.
goal.zh: 通过 17 个任务系列、25 个档案探索原创工业科幻舰队。三艘已建模舰船各保留七个高清视图；规划设计明确使用占位，并保留未知尺寸。

role.en: Framework-free fleet browsing and accessible image inspection
role.zh: 无运行时框架的舰队浏览与无障碍图像查看

role.en: Public website, versioned health JSON and immutable ship media
role.zh: 公开站点、版本化健康 JSON 与不可变舰船素材

role.en: Original spacecraft models and reproducible seven-view renders
role.zh: 原创舰船模型与可复现的七视图渲染

description.en: Three staggered chevron approach vectors, broken range arcs and docking alignment ticks connect mission-based fleet formations and engineering archives. This geometry is specific to Zeppelin.
description.zh: 错落的接近向量、测距弧与对接刻度压印在冷调工程纸上，呼应任务编队与舰船工程档案。

alt.en: Titanium fleet command vessel with yellow bands on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 带黄色识别带的钛金属舰队指挥舰，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.en: A titanium command vessel for an original next-generation spacecraft fleet.
description.zh: 以钛金属指挥舰，呈现原创次世代太空舰队。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥84px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine material detail softens at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 84px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小材质细节会柔化。
